values.note: $26 a night in the main season (mid-May to September 30, pay by Scan & Pay); $15 from October 1 to November 30, when the Forest Service runs it with no drinking water. A second vehicle on a site is $6 a night extra. Read 2026-11-21.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10381955/rates (Standard $26, 2026-2028 seasons) + rec.gov notice ('Daily Fee is $15 per First Come First Served campsite' off season; '$6.00 per night on the second vehicle'), read 2026-11-21

values.note: Full services mid-May to September 30; October 1 to November 30 the Forest Service runs it without drinking water, and the road is not maintained. Closed from December 1 for snowmobile routes.

season.source: rec.gov notice ('open season from May 15th to September 30th'; 'off season (from 10/01 until 11/30th) the USFS operates this campground. Closes on 12/01/2026 for snowmobile routes') + FS page ('closes for the season on December 1 each year')

sites.source: FS page ('seven camp sites') + rec.gov catalog (Max Vehicle Length 24-44 ft; none typed pull-through)

facilities.source: rec.gov amenities ('Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Vault Toilets'); off-season notice 'Drinking water is NOT available'

values.note: First-come only; pay with Scan & Pay at the site.

booking.source: FS page ('Reservations are not available ... Sites are available first come, first served') + rec.gov facility_rules 'S&P Only' and FCFS rate seasons

note: Small Black Hills NF campground in Spearfish Canyon, about 3 mi up Roughlock Falls Rd from US-14A at Savoy, beside Little Spearfish Creek. Gravel back-in spurs of 24-44 ft; the Little Spearfish and Rimrock trails start at the campground and Roughlock Falls is nearby. --Claude
summary: rec.gov record/rates/catalog + FS page: 7 FCFS non-electric gravel sites (spurs 24-44 ft, six RV-eligible), hand-pump water, vault toilets; rec.gov $26 mid-May-Sep 30 (FS page still $24), $15 Oct-Nov without water, closed Dec 1 to mid-May; Scan & Pay. Fees 24 -> 15-26; season opens/closes added; max_rig_ft 30 -> 44. Not waterfront kept (road between sites and creek). Pin fine.
flags: FEES: rec.gov rate table $26 (2026, 2027, 2028 seasons) vs FS page 'Peak Season: $24 / night' - wrote rec.gov's $26 (FS page stale). Shoulder $15 agrees on both.
SITES: max_rig_ft 30 (note prose) -> 44 (rec.gov catalog; site 1 is 24 ft, site 2 36 ft, the rest 42-44 ft). Site 7 (42 ft) lists only Tent/Vehicle equipment; six RV-eligible sites.

OPERATOR: run by concessioner ExplorUS in the main season (rec.gov notice; contact (661) 702-1420), USFS Oct 1-Nov 30. Stored phone (605) 642-4622 is the Northern Hills Ranger District (FS page) - fine. The rec.gov off-season notice names Hell Canyon RD 605.673.9200 (wrong district, as earlier batches found).
WEBSITE: both links (rec.gov 10381955 + fs.usda.gov r02 page) confirmed.
ACCESS: the old note's 'gravel, can be rutty' had no agency source and was dropped; no agency rig restriction on Roughlock Falls Rd; rec.gov: 'roads are not maintained during the off-season'.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - FS says 'adjacent to Little Spearfish Creek', but on USGS imagery the sites ring a small loop on the north side of Roughlock Falls Rd, with the road and trees between them and the creek bottom (Esri imagery cloud-covered here).

PIN: stored 44.33829,-103.96310 is ~60 m south of the loop (sites 1-7 at 44.3385-44.3388, -103.9629..-103.9648) - fine. Marketing mentions OHV riders; this is a general campground, not an OHV staging area.
